Zero

Zero is the distinguished starting value for one common construction of the natural numbers.

editorialnumber-theory · arithmetic
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

Zero is the distinguished starting value for one common construction of the natural numbers.

EXACT

The compact statement

In a Peano-style structure (N,0,S), 0∈N and 0 is not the successor of any element.

Example

Counting no selected objects gives 0.

Boundary / caveat

Some conventions start the natural numbers at 1; the index convention must be stated.

Assumptions

  • The declared natural-number arithmetic context is fixed.
